name: Clyde
description:
Get a call if someone attempts to steal you Mac while you’re away.
No more, “Hey, could you watch my stuff please?”

How Clyde works
	1. Toggle Clyde
	2. Leave the lid open
	3. Walk Away

Clyde is easy to use and provides peace of mind when you use your laptop in public places. When someone tries to close your MacBook’s lid when Clyde is turned on, you will get a call on your Apple Watch/Phone. 

You can also choose to sound a loud alarm on your Mac in case that happens. To disarm the alarm, simply sign into your Mac and the alarm will turn off. With Clyde, you can rest assured that your laptop is safe and sound.

Get a free version of Clyde which rings an alarm on your Mac if somebody attempts theft. You do not get notified on your phone/watch with this version.
